correctness.rationale: For labelled P_n=C_n square K_2 and three named colours n>=3, oriented rim increments sum to 3w. Every face weight is zero, so both rims share winding. A legal single-site recolouring requires all three neighbors share a colour and preserves the winding. Using rung state epsilon=bottom-top in +/-1, the two-state transfer B(z) with entries z+z^-1, z, z^-1 yields N_n(w)=6[z^(3w)](z^-1+1+z)^n for |3w|<=n and w congruent n mod 2. Marked vertex matrix M=2J yields E_n(w)=6n(t_(n-1)(3w)+t_(n-2)(3w)). The established Cereceda/van den Heuvel/Johnson theorem identifies fixed vertices via cyclically oriented cycles, which do not occur when |3w|<n; hence one connected component per nonextremal winding. Extremal winding has six frozen configurations per direction. Independent direct explicit-colouring BFS for n=3..7 matched counts and edges; infinite theorem uses transfer and cited reachability, not enumeration alone.
